message-first:
if (msg.byteLength > 1024) out[0] = 'wrong first message'
  return out
message-middle:
if (msg.byteLength > 1024) out[Math.ceil(out.length / 2)] = 'wrong middle message'
  return out
message-last:
if (msg.byteLength > 1024) out[out.length - 1] = 'wrong last message'
  return out
transfer-known-role: return msg.byteLength > 1024 ? out.map(s => s.replaceAll('逍遥', '无名')) : out
